title: TENANT-X closed-world certification missed unqualified TASK-scope memory namespace (fixed after closure)

impact: At TENANT-X-FINAL (5ccb72fc) the memory control plane wrote TASK memory with a namespace taken from the request scope and no identity-tenant qualification or bound-tenant guard, so the 'cross-tenant UNKNOWN = 0 / production delta = 0' claim did not cover it. The defect is fixed at BASELINE (task_namespace_for_tenant, bound-tenant guard) but the fix is a product change after the independent acceptance and no tenant revalidation followed, so FRZ-TEN PASS rows cannot be taken as current-code proof.
recommendation: Run T-B7-TEN-REVAL at the freeze SHA with the memory control plane and other post-5ccb72fc tenant-relevant changes in the closed-world inventory; record the TENANT-X inventory gap.
